title: Two Motors
instructions:
The `Motor` class is already defined. Complete the `main` function to:
1. Create a Motor named `"Left Drive"` with speed `0.6`
2. Create a Motor named `"Right Drive"` with speed `0.9`
3. Print each motor's name and speed in the format: `"{name}: {speed}"`
hint: Create each Motor with `Motor("Left Drive", 0.6)` and use string templates to print: `"${motor.name}: ${motor.speed}"`.
